column1: # J-128 alignment gate: scopes whose count of a rule may rise above the baseline.
# Only free-form layouts belong here (keyboards, curve and envelope editors, XY pads),
# never a row of knobs. Every line needs a justification.

column3: keyboard: the black keys sit over the white keys by design
key-zone map: each zone's sample name is clipped to its own zone on purpose
free-form curve editor: points and handles sit inside the curve area
free-form envelope editor: the RESET button floats inside the envelope area
notes text field: its scrolling child area registers as a second item over the field
